answer: Hold every identity to Tailor seam assay lodged with the tailors guild. The holding costs 3-year apprenticeship, 154 supervised seams, guild exam, 71 POA annual fee, renewal, and the farm holds a hundred of them. The farm's budget must cover 529 proofs at 110 POA each — 58190 POA — before any reward is even possible. Follow the ember back to the office that issued it, follow the glacier back to the wallet that paid it, and follow the reef back to the year it was filed. Pay the price or stay outside: the pool belongs to whoever paid.
